title: What to collect next: what each column group adds with its interval, the usual kinds missing, where more rows help (34.14)
request: The owner asked to finish Phase 10 without stopping. The plan (docs/guides/PHASE10_ABILITIES_PLAN.md, 34.14) asks for feature-group ablation on the folds, the segments where labels would help, the data-need agent's questions, active learning an option and never the default, and on a replica with a planted missing group the advice naming that group's kind.
spec: dclab_core/collect.py (CollectAdvice v1, advise); dclab_rnd/studio/collect.py (the groups weighed as a job on the training folds).
plan: group the columns by a domain's usual kinds
weigh each group on the training folds
name the usual kinds no column matches
carry 34.13's segments and the data-need questions

decisions.decision: Keep three readings apart: measured, prior knowledge, passed through
decisions.why: a missing kind can never be measured on a table that lacks it

decisions.decision: Name a group only when its interval is above zero
decisions.why: a drop of a few ten-thousandths is noise

decisions.decision: Match names by whole word parts, the longest word winning
decisions.why: short words inside longer names gave wrong kinds both ways

change: dclab_core/collect.py (new); dclab_rnd/studio/collect.py (new); a job, two routes, an event; contracts and schemas; tests.

findings.defect: segments from a real learning curve read as none
findings.scenario: a 34.13 segment named its column and level, the advice read other names
findings.cause: the shape was invented in the test
findings.fix: the column and level read; the words leaving the record name the column only
findings.impact: the advice said labels help in none

findings.defect: the data-need questions never reached a project
findings.scenario: the advice read a key nothing writes
findings.cause: a guessed place for the questions
findings.fix: the confirmed problem map's needs against the data card

findings.scenario: a score that fell without tenure was written as a plus sign without it
findings.cause: a signed number with no verb
findings.fix: the measure falls by an amount without the group

findings.defect: a group's reading had no interval
findings.scenario: noise of a few ten-thousandths could be named as what the score rests on
findings.fix: a paired bootstrap on the same rows; named only above zero; over ten seeds the unused groups were named 0 of 20

findings.defect: overlapping groups were read as carrying nothing
findings.scenario: a fee priced by the plan: each reads as adding little
findings.cause: the reading is what a group adds beyond the others
findings.fix: said as such, with the assumption in the record

findings.defect: column names matched the wrong kinds
findings.scenario: count inside account and country, ip inside shipping and zip, week inside sales_last_week, TechSupport as a support contact, age inside marriage
findings.fix: whole word parts and plurals, the longest word winning; the matches shown to correct

findings.defect: a project in no known domain was not weighed at all
findings.scenario: an income table outside the five domains
findings.cause: measuring was tied to the domain
findings.fix: each column weighed on its own

findings.defect: the label sentence claimed more than 34.13 measures
findings.cause: 34.13 measures whether the score still rises with all rows
findings.fix: said as the score still rising there, labels may help; a stale curve not used

findings.defect: the event made prior knowledge look measured
findings.scenario: the missing kinds listed as the rule's choice
findings.fix: the answerer named as prior knowledge

measurements.name: naming over ten seeds
measurements.gate: the groups the outcome used named in at least 9 of 10; an unused group named in at most 1 of 20
measurements.result: tenure and support named 10 of 10; the plan and the fee 0 of 20
limits: simulated rows and a linear model

outcome: A project can be told which column groups its score leans on, with intervals, which usual kinds of data its table lacks, said as prior knowledge, and where more rows still help.
lessons: Say where each part of an advice comes from: measured, prior knowledge or passed through.
A short word inside a longer name is not a match.
risks: a domain's usual kinds are a list someone wrote
a group that overlaps another reads as little
